verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's own incentives, remuneration and benefits page says it advises on 'the full range of employee incentives', naming tax-advantaged EMI, company share option plans and growth shares. Its EC&VC page also lists incentives specialists among the teams that support startups from incorporation to exit. Missing for 10: any evidence of German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOP work, detail on how the firm designs plans, and independent corroboration.
